name: Clean Zone
summary: Gnomes hold the Clean Zone as a refuge inside ruined Gnomeregan. Beyond the upper Hall of Gears, this fortified enclave remains safe amid the irradiated city, where medics, technicians, and Sparklematic machines support the defenders and salvage work.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Slag
sections.body: The Clean Zone remains untainted while most of Gnomeregan fell to Mekkatorque's disastrous venting of radioactive waste. It lies between the trogg-infested Dormitory below and the contested corridors of the Hall of Gears above. Gnome defenders, technicians, and field medics hold its barricades day and night. Alliance expeditions can regroup here, tend their wounds, and maintain their machinery.

sections.title: The Sparklematic 5200
sections.body: The Clean Zone also supports salvage from Gnomeregan's ruined capital. Gnomish engineers installed Sparklematic 5200 units to scrub and wash grime-encrusted relics brought up from the city's radioactive depths. Technicians and merchants such as Tink Sprocketwhistle process the reclaimed gears and baubles, outfit adventurers, and study the toxic fallout in the deep tunnels.

faq.q: Why isn't this area irradiated like the rest of Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Gnomes in the Clean Zone remain unaffected by the radiation that devastated Gnomeregan. No account explains exactly why this small area escaped contamination.

faq.q: What do the Sparklematic 5200 machines do?
faq.answer: Sparklematic 5200s are gnomish machines that launder and decontaminate objects. Adventurers can put grime-encrusted objects taken from troggs and leper gnomes inside. The machines wash away radioactive grime and reveal useful ores, gems, coins, or engineering oddities.

faq.q: Who controls and defends the Clean Zone?
faq.answer: Uncorrupted gnomish guards, field medics, and technicians hold the Clean Zone's perimeter. They fight troggs advancing from the Dormitory and leper gnomes descending from the upper levels to keep the staging post secure.

faq.q: Can players safely rest or repair here?
aliases: can you rest in clean zone
faq.answer: Yes. The Clean Zone is a field camp inside Gnomeregan, with engineering supplies, repairs from Tink Sprocketwhistle, and a working mailbox for adventurers behind the front lines.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see the Clean Zone as a grim reminder of your home's fall and a beacon of hope that Gnomeregan's technology can still be reclaimed from the troggs.
As an engineer, you can use the working Sparklematic 5200 units here to scour irradiated junk for rare schematics and mechanical parts. Merchant Tink Sprocketwhistle is also here.
